title: Not impressed
text: Not impressed. This thing is very flimsy. I got it for someone who can’t have flame in their bedroom but wanted a menorah. First, this seems to work only on battery. Not sure why there is even a cord. The battery compartment has to be unscrewed and the screw head is tiny. We got it off but then saw there was no + or - sign on the battery slots so the person this was for could not put in the batteries. So much for plug and go. This menorah is certainly not that. At any rate, after hunting for and finding a screwdriver small enough, the putting in the batteries, closing it back up etc., we decided it was kind of a pain in the butt. I would not recommend it and I doubt it will survive being put away with the Chanukah decorations next week. This year, after frustration, it’s doing its job but next year we will be better prepared and invest in a nicer one that is as the seller describes it. This one just isn’t.
